title.en: An Act Appropriating Twenty thousand Pesos for the Construction of An Intermediate School in the Municipality of Orion, Province of Bataan. as a Memorial to Cayetano S. Arellano, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The sum of twenty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be expended for the construction of an intermediate school in the
municipality of Orion, Province of Bataan, as a memorial to Cayetano S. Arellano.

The building to be constructed with said funds hall have on its facade, a bust or relief figure of
Cayetano S. Arellano and such inscriptions in bronze or marble as may be approved in accordance with
existing regulations. Provincial

In case this sum is not sufficient for the purpose above mentioned, the provincial board of
Bataan and of municipal council Orion, in said province, may appropriate from their respective funds the sum
necessary for the completion of the building: Provided, That in case neither the province nor the municipality
have sufficient funds for this purpose, voluntary contributions may be solicited.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
